Summer camp has come once again, but
Symboli
Rudolf seems far more relaxed
this time around.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She's perfectly content to watch the
curtain rise
on the camp as nothing more
than another
student of Tracen
Academy.
